Clarify live E2E paid Agent invocation counts in docs

codeon:

  authority: FWN-1
  description: |-
    The live acceptance path invokes one paid Agent per Agent-owned Operation, not a single run. Document the minimum (Implementation and Review with default planning_mode=skip) and conditional stages (Planning when required; Revision plus follow-up Review when Review requests changes) in the Justfile, live_e2e harness module docs, and OpenWiki guide so opt-in cost and side effects are accurately described.
